name: sidwave-monorepo
description: Workspace root of the SIDWAVE repository: packages sidwave and c64-asm6502
author: Christian Gleissner

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.test:bun: npm run build && npm run test:bun --workspaces
scripts.pack: npm run build && node --eval "import('node:fs').then((fs) => fs.mkdirSync('artifacts', { recursive: true }))" && npm pack --workspaces --pack-destination ./artifacts
